html:
Lax Yuup is the territory of the Gitga'at, a Tsimshian people of the north coast of British Columbia. It covers the islands and inlets around the village of Hartley Bay, at the mouth of Douglas Channel south of Prince Rupert.

The land includes Gribbell Island, home of many white spirit bears, a rare form of the black bear. The Gitga'at gather seaweed, halibut, salmon and shellfish here at seasonal camps, as they have for centuries. They have strongly opposed plans to send oil tankers through Douglas Channel, which runs through their waters to the port of Kitimat, home of the Haisla.
